revalidation.reason: The A0 v4 cohort-authority repair invalidated downstream completion records. This Evidence rebinds the A4 stage-signature and provider-port surface to the sole v3.0 authority after a current-state source review.
repaired_hazards: PromptCompiler now serializes approved input with allow_nan=False, so NaN and Infinity cannot enter the provider prompt or its deterministic input digest.

A live A0 control regression verifies next-task selection from the first incomplete ledger task; a pre-existing untracked A4 blocker allegation of a hard-coded A1 selector was therefore not used as authority or completion proof.

authority_boundary.i0: The provider may return only FactExtractionDraft fields. FactAssembler remains the sole local owner of source-span validation, canonical fact IDs, opaque handles, registry membership, provenance, and hashes.
authority_boundary.b1: The provider may return only creative Draft values, DurationIntent, and typed reference/dialogue binding intents. It cannot mint canonical IDs, hashes, ticks, timelines, VEC, ProjectionAST, or requirements.
authority_boundary.binding: Reference and dialogue are carried only as typed intent fields. Free text remains explanatory and is not a machine-binding transport; the later local VEC assembler verifies approved-handle membership and semantic responsibility.
authority_boundary.provider: Only the native structured-schema provider port is accepted. On Windows it selects claude.exe rather than a cmd shim; unsupported native-schema capability fails before any model call; schema transport remains separate from prompt text; one RepairBudget permits exactly one scoped ContractPatch.
authority_boundary.prompt: Prompt text excludes the output schema, is preflight budgeted, and now rejects nonfinite JSON values before a provider invocation or input-digest computation.

non_goals: No A5 timeline/VEC implementation, A6 Projection implementation, A7 media/approval implementation, later-package implementation, v4 production code, or production switch was changed.
No external provider, Director, DP, renderer, or media call was started.
No text, schema, structure, or simulated provider result is represented as visual acceptance.
